privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro.title: Introduction
privacy.intro.text: SnapSong is operated by TrueTapp – Mobile Apps Ltda, a company based in Brazil. This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, and the measures we take to protect your privacy. SnapSong lets you choose or capture a photo on your device and sends the data described below to third-party AI services only when you intentionally start song generation.
privacy.collect.title: Information We Collect
privacy.collect.userContent.title: User Content
privacy.collect.userContent.text: When you use SnapSong, you may choose a photo from your library or capture one with your device camera. Those photos may include people and visible facial features. When you start song generation, SnapSong uses the selected photo, your optional keywords, and the derived song assets needed to create your song. Song metadata is stored with SwiftData, while original photos, audio files, and cover artwork are stored as local files in the app sandbox on your device. No photo is sent to a third party unless you intentionally start song generation.
privacy.faceData.title: Face Data
privacy.faceData.definition.title: Face Data We Collect
privacy.faceData.definition.text: SnapSong collects face data only when you intentionally select or capture a photo for song generation and that photo contains visible facial features. SnapSong does not create or store a faceprint, biometric template, face geometry, depth map, recognition profile, landmark map, or facial embedding from that photo.
privacy.faceData.use.title: How We Use Face Data
privacy.faceData.use.text: If your selected photo includes a face, SnapSong may send that photo to OpenAI only when you start song generation. OpenAI uses the photo for visual scene analysis and to produce derived creative inputs such as a photo brief, lyrics, title, and style needed to generate the song. SnapSong does not use face data for identity recognition, authentication, profiling, advertising, marketing, surveillance, analytics enrichment, or matching one person, user, or photo against another.
privacy.faceData.sharing.title: Sharing and Storage of Face Data
privacy.faceData.sharing.text: OpenAI is the only third party that may receive a selected photo that contains face data, and it receives that photo only for the visual analysis described in this policy. Suno does not receive the photo or face data and receives only derived song inputs such as lyrics, title, and style. SnapSong stores the original photo locally in the app sandbox on your device and does not maintain its own server copy of that photo or its face data.
privacy.faceData.retention.title: Retention of Face Data
privacy.faceData.retention.text: That local photo remains on your device until you delete the related song or uninstall the app.
privacy.faceData.biometric.title: Face ID and App Lock
privacy.faceData.biometric.text: SnapSong may let you enable Face ID or Touch ID App Lock through iOS LocalAuthentication. This feature is handled by Apple on your device. SnapSong does not receive, access, or store any Face ID template or other biometric template; the app only receives the authentication result and stores your local preference for whether App Lock is enabled.
privacy.collect.usageData.title: Usage Data
privacy.collect.usageData.text: We collect anonymous usage data about how you interact with the app, including feature usage patterns, session duration, and generation history. This data is not linked to your identity and helps us understand how the app is used to improve its performance and user experience.
privacy.collect.diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
privacy.collect.diagnostics.text: Crash logs, performance metrics, and other diagnostic information are collected automatically by Apple's systems. This data is not linked to your personal identity and is used to identify and fix technical issues.
privacy.use.title: How We Use Your Information
privacy.use.service: To provide the SnapSong service by analyzing the photo you intentionally submit for generation and generating a personalized song from derived creative inputs
privacy.use.improve: To improve the app's features, performance, and user experience
privacy.use.bugs: To identify, troubleshoot, and fix technical issues and bugs
privacy.use.communication: To communicate with you about important updates or changes to the service (if you contact us)
privacy.thirdParty.title: Third-Party Services
privacy.thirdParty.openai.title: OpenAI
privacy.thirdParty.openai.text: The selected photo you submit for generation is sent to OpenAI's Responses API for visual analysis, and derived text inputs may also be processed by OpenAI to generate lyrics, title, and style. OpenAI states that API data is not used to train its models by default. OpenAI also states that abuse monitoring logs may be retained for up to 30 days and that the Responses API has a 30-day application state retention period by default. Face-data-specific disclosure and storage details are described in the Face Data section above. For current details, please review OpenAI's data controls documentation.
privacy.thirdParty.suno.title: Suno
privacy.thirdParty.suno.text: SnapSong sends Suno only derived song inputs such as lyrics, title, and style to generate audio. SnapSong does not send Suno the original photo or face data. Suno states in its Privacy Notice that information is generally stored on servers located in the United States and retained as reasonably necessary for the purposes described there. For current details, please review Suno's Privacy Notice.
privacy.thirdParty.apple.title: Apple
privacy.thirdParty.apple.text: SnapSong uses Apple's built-in analytics and crash reporting systems through the App Store. SnapSong may also let you use Face ID or Touch ID App Lock through iOS LocalAuthentication, which is handled by Apple on your device. The app does not receive or store Face ID templates or other biometric templates. Additionally, the Creative Intelligence Engine leverages Apple Foundation Models that run entirely on your device. For more information, see Apple's Privacy Policy.
privacy.thirdParty.noteSelling: SnapSong does not sell your data to any third parties. We do not use advertising SDKs or share your information with advertisers.
privacy.storage.title: Data Storage & Security
privacy.storage.text: SnapSong stores song metadata locally with SwiftData and stores user content—including original photos, generated audio, and cover artwork—as local files in the app sandbox on your device. SnapSong does not require user accounts, does not sync your content to a TrueTapp cloud server, and does not maintain a centralized server copy of your original photos or face data. This design ensures your generated content remains under your control.
privacy.storage.security: We implement industry-standard security practices to protect data in transit when communicating with third-party APIs. However, no method of electronic storage is completely secure. We encourage you to use strong device passcodes and keep your iOS operating system up to date.
privacy.onDevice.title: On-Device Intelligence
privacy.onDevice.text: SnapSong's Creative Intelligence Engine uses Apple Foundation Models, which run entirely on your device. The musical history and preference signals used by this feature are processed locally and are not transmitted to external servers for analysis or training.
privacy.retention.title: Data Retention
privacy.retention.text: Data stored on your device persists until you explicitly delete songs or uninstall the app. When you delete a song within SnapSong, all associated files (audio, cover art, and original photo) are removed from your device. Uninstalling the app removes all local SnapSong data from your device.
privacy.retention.thirdParty: SnapSong does not keep its own server-side copy of requests sent to OpenAI and Suno after processing. Face-data-specific retention details are described in the Face Data section above. OpenAI states in its current API data controls that abuse monitoring logs may be retained for up to 30 days and that the Responses API has a 30-day application state retention period by default. Suno states in its Privacy Notice that information is generally retained as reasonably necessary for the purposes described there. Because SnapSong does not send face data to Suno, Suno does not receive or retain face data from SnapSong.
privacy.children.title: Children's Privacy
privacy.children.text: SnapSong does not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13 years of age. If you believe a child under 13 has provided personal information through the app, please contact us immediately at snapsong@truetapp.com so we can take appropriate action.
privacy.rights.title: Your Rights
privacy.rights.delete: You have the right to delete any song and its associated data at any time directly within the SnapSong app
privacy.rights.uninstall: You can remove all SnapSong data from your device by uninstalling the app
privacy.rights.access: You can access your own content (songs, photos) that is stored on your device at any time
privacy.rights.contact: If you have questions about your data or wish to exercise your rights, contact us at snapsong@truetapp.com
privacy.changes.title: Changes to This Policy
privacy.changes.text: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices, technology, legal requirements, or other factors. When we make material changes, we will update the "Last updated" date at the top of this policy. Your continued use of SnapSong after any changes indicates your acceptance of the updated Privacy Policy.
privacy.contact.title: Contact Us
privacy.contact.text: If you have any questions, concerns, or requests regarding this Privacy Policy or our privacy practices, please contact us:
